title: H3 Subtype Avian Influenza Virus: Ecology, Cross-Species Evolution, and Public Health Threats
abstract: H3 subtype avian influenza virus (AIV) is one of the most widely distributed and frequently detected low-pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (LPAIVs) in wild birds and poultry worldwide. Wild waterfowl are the natural reservoir of this virus. In recent years, driven by frequent genetic reassortment and continuous evolution, H3 subtype AIV has expanded its host range to include various mammalian species—dogs, cats, horses, seals, pigs (experimental infection), and humans. Among these, the H3N8 subtype shows the broadest cross-species transmissibility, having established sustained transmission lineages in horses and dogs, while also causing sporadic infections in seals and humans. Avian-origin H3N2 canine influenza virus has circulated stably in dog populations across Asia and North America for nearly two decades. Between 2022 and 2023, China reported three human cases of H3N8 subtype AIV infection, one of which was fatal (Guangdong, March 2023), indicating that this virus poses a potential zoonotic transmission risk. Novel triple-reassortant strains, including genotype G25 of H3N8 and H3N3, first detected in chicken flocks in late 2022, have continued to emerge. Their HA genes originate from H3 subtype viruses of wild bird or chicken origin, whereas their internal gene segments are predominantly acquired from H9N2 subtype AIV, resulting in enhanced mammalian adaptability. This review summarizes the global epidemiology of H3 subtype AIV (covering wild birds, poultry, and live poultry markets), its genetic evolution and reassortment patterns, and the molecular mechanisms underlying cross-species transmission. This review particularly highlights the regulatory roles of key amino acid mutations—such as PB2-D701N, M1-M192V, and HA-Q226L/G228S—in receptor binding preference, polymerase activity, and pathogenicity. This review also summarizes recent advances in detection techniques (multiplex RT-PCR, quantum dot-based immunochromatographic strips, RT-RAA, and CRISPR-Cas13a) and vaccine development (inactivated, adenovirus-vectored, and mRNA vaccines). Key prevention and control challenges—including covert circulation, surveillance gaps, and limited subtyping diagnostic capacity at primary laboratories—are also discussed. This review proposes that H3 subtype AIV should be recognized as a potential zoonotic threat warranting continued surveillance, although no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission has been documented to date. Better understanding of cross-species mechanisms, stronger surveillance and early warning, and evidence-based control strategies are needed to inform future risk assessment.

It also discusses the potential zoonotic risk of H3N8 AIV, as evidenced by human infections in China. The review underscores the need for improved surveillance, diagnostic capacity, and risk assessment strategies to address the challenges posed by H3 AIV's cross-species transmission capabilities.

title_zh: H3 亚型 禽流感 病毒:生态、跨物种 进化 和公共健康威胁
source_body_en: H3 subtype avian influenza virus (AIV) is one of the most widely distributed and frequently detected low-pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (LPAIVs) in wild birds and poultry worldwide. Wild waterfowl are the natural reservoir of this virus. In recent years, driven by frequent genetic reassortment and continuous evolution, H3 subtype AIV has expanded its host range to include various mammalian species—dogs, cats, horses, seals, pigs (experimental infection), and humans. Among these, the H3N8 subtype shows the broadest cross-species transmissibility, having established sustained transmission lineages in horses and dogs, while also causing sporadic infections in seals and humans. Avian-origin H3N2 canine influenza virus has circulated stably in dog populations across Asia and North America for nearly two decades. Between 2022 and 2023, China reported three human cases of H3N8 subtype AIV infection, one of which was fatal (Guangdong, March 2023), indicating that this virus poses a potential zoonotic transmission risk. Novel triple-reassortant strains, including genotype G25 of H3N8 and H3N3, first detected in chicken flocks in late 2022, have continued to emerge. Their HA genes originate from H3 subtype viruses of wild bird or chicken origin, whereas their internal gene segments are predominantly acquired from H9N2 subtype AIV, resulting in enhanced mammalian adaptability. This review summarizes the global epidemiology of H3 subtype AIV (covering wild birds, poultry, and live poultry markets), its genetic evolution and reassortment patterns, and the molecular mechanisms underlying cross-species transmission. This review particularly highlights the regulatory roles of key amino acid mutations—such as PB2-D701N, M1-M192V, and HA-Q226L/G228S—in receptor binding preference, polymerase activity, and pathogenicity. This review also summarizes recent advances in detection techniques (multiplex RT-PCR, quantum dot-based immunochromatographic strips, RT-RAA, and CRISPR-Cas13a) and vaccine development (inactivated, adenovirus-vectored, and mRNA vaccines). Key prevention and control challenges—including covert circulation, surveillance gaps, and limited subtyping diagnostic capacity at primary laboratories—are also discussed. This review proposes that H3 subtype AIV should be recognized as a potential zoonotic threat warranting continued surveillance, although no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission has been documented to date. Better understanding of cross-species mechanisms, stronger surveillance and early warning, and evidence-based control strategies are needed to inform future risk assessment.

title: Pre-existing cross-subtype serological responses against H5Nx in health care workers
abstract: UNLABELLED: A rise in cases of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b in humans has been reported since 2023. Although influenza seasonal vaccination (H1N1/H3N2) was shown to be effective against cases of reinfection with endemic influenza A viruses (IAVs), its capacity to elicit cross-reactive antibodies against (H5N1) remains unclear. Here, we measured vaccine-elicited antibody responses against seasonal (H1N1/H3N2) and various avian subtypes A (H5Nx) using plasma samples from the CRCHUM Health Care Workers cohort in Montreal, Canada, during the 2024 influenza seasonal vaccination. The capacity of their plasma to recognize hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) antigens from ten influenza strains was measured. Their neutralizing activity, as well as their capacity to mediate antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) against cells stably expressing HA and NA, was measured. Overall, seasonal vaccination against H1N1/H3N2 elicited antibodies able to recognize several HA and NA, and in some individuals, this translated to increased neutralization and ADCC activity, including against H5Nx. This study provides insightful information on how vaccination shapes cross-reactive antibody responses against avian H5Nx. IMPORTANCE: Influenza A viruses (IAVs) are endemic in the human population and responsible for hundreds of thousands of deaths every year, occasionally leading to influenza pandemics. Since 2023, there has been a rise in avian IAV infections in humans, with some deaths reported, mostly related to the H5N1 subtype clade 2.3.4.4b. Seasonal vaccines against IAVs are effective, but their efficacy against avian IAVs is not well known. Here, following influenza seasonal vaccination in a cohort of adults, we report highly heterogeneous serological responses, possibly due to pre-existing immunity and HA sequence similarity. These findings provide insight into the breadth of pre-existing and vaccine-induced immunity against H5 influenza viruses and may inform the development of vaccination strategies aimed at providing broader protection against emerging influenza viruses.

Although influenza seasonal vaccination (H1N1/H3N2) was shown to be effective against cases of reinfection with endemic influenza A viruses (IAVs), its capacity to elicit cross-reactive antibodies against (H5N1) remains unclear. Here, we measured vaccine-elicited antibody responses against seasonal (H1N1/H3N2) and various avian subtypes A (H5Nx) using plasma samples from the CRCHUM Health Care Workers cohort in Montreal, Canada, during the 2024 influenza seasonal vaccination. The capacity of their plasma to recognize hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) antigens from ten influenza strains was measured. Their neutralizing activity, as well as their capacity to mediate antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) against cells stably expressing HA and NA, was measured. Overall, seasonal vaccination against H1N1/H3N2 elicited antibodies able to recognize several HA and NA, and in some individuals, this translated to increased neutralization and ADCC activity, including against H5Nx. This study provides insightful information on how vaccination shapes cross-reactive antibody responses against avian H5Nx. IMPORTANCE Influenza A viruses (IAVs) are endemic in the human population and responsible for hundreds of thousands of deaths every year, occasionally leading to influenza pandemics. Since 2023, there has been a rise in avian IAV infections in humans, with some deaths reported, mostly related to the H5N1 subtype clade 2.3.4.4b. Seasonal vaccines against IAVs are effective, but their efficacy against avian IAVs is not well known. Here, following influenza seasonal vaccination in a cohort of adults, we report highly heterogeneous serological responses, possibly due to pre-existing immunity and HA sequence similarity. These findings provide insight into the breadth of pre-existing and vaccine-induced immunity against H5 influenza viruses and may inform the development of vaccination strategies aimed at providing broader protection against emerging influenza viruses.

abstract_zh: 未标记:自 2023 年以来,据报道人类 高致病性禽流感 A (H5N1) 分支 2.3.4.4b 病例有所增加。尽管季节性流感 疫苗接种 (H1N1/H3N2) 被证明可有效对抗地方性甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 的再感染病例,但其引发针对 (H5N1) 交叉反应抗体的能力仍不清楚。在这里,我们使用 2024 年流感季节性 疫苗接种 期间加拿大蒙特利尔 CRCHUM 卫生保健工作者 队列研究 的血浆样本测量了 疫苗 引发的针对季节性 (H1N1/H3N2) 和各种禽类 A 亚型 (H5Nx) 的抗体反应。测量了它们的血浆识别十种流感病毒株的血凝素(HA)和神经氨酸酶(NA)抗原的能力。测量了它们的中和活性,以及​​它们介导针对稳定表达 HA 和 NA 的细胞的抗体依赖性细胞毒性 (ADCC) 的能力。总体而言,针对 H1N1/H3N2 的季节性 疫苗接种 引发了能够识别多种 HA 和 NA 的抗体,并且在某些个体中,这转化为中和和 ADCC 活性的增加,包括针对 H5Nx 的抗体。这项研究提供了有关 疫苗接种 如何形成针对禽类 H5Nx 的交叉反应抗体反应的深刻信息。重要性:甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 在人群中流行,每年导致数十万人死亡,有时还会导致流感大流行。自 2023 年以来,人类感染禽类 IAV 的数量有所增加,并报告了一些死亡病例,其中大部分与 H5N1 亚型分支 2.3.4.4b 有关。季节性 疫苗 对 IAV 有效,但其对禽 IAV 的功效尚不清楚。在这里,在成人 队列研究 中出现季节性流感 队列研究 后,我们报告了高度异质性的血清学反应,可能是由于预先存在的免疫力和 HA 序列相似性。这些发现提供了对预先存在的和 疫苗 诱导的针对 H5 流感病毒的免疫力的广度的深入了解,并可能为 疫苗接种 策略的开发提供信息,该策略旨在针对新出现的流感病毒提供更广泛的保护。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究深入了解了 疫苗接种 如何形成针对禽类 H5Nx 的交叉反应抗体反应,强调了预先存在的免疫和 疫苗 诱导的反应为针对新出现的流感病毒提供更广泛保护的潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为 疫苗接种 战略的制定提供信息,该战略旨在针对新出现的流感病毒,特别是针对 H5Nx 提供更广泛的保护。

title: Multiple introductions and spread of novel reassortant highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b viruses via wild birds, South Korea, 2024–2025
abstract: Abstract Between 14 October 2024 and 24 March 2025, 43 cases of clade 2.3.4.4b highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) type A (H5N1) infections in wild birds and 1 case in a leopard cat were detected through the national HPAI surveillance program. We performed whole-genome sequencing of 51 isolates and investigated their phylogenetic relationships. Phylogenetic analyses identified nine distinct genotypes, designated Kor24–25A to Kor24–25I. The most commonly detected genotype, Kor24–25A ( n = 24), was frequently detected in Pelecaniformes and was most prevalent between December 2024 and January 2025. Bayesian continuous and discrete trait phylodynamic analyses using HA gene sequences identified the three most probable routes of viral introduction via Gyeonggi, Jeju, and the southern coastal areas of the Korean Peninsula and suggested that wild ducks served as the primary reservoirs facilitating viral transmission in the wild bird population. During the 2024–2025 season, great egrets ( Ardea alba ) appeared to be more frequently affected than other wild bird species, suggesting possible seasonal differences in species-specific disease outcomes among wild birds. This study provides valuable insights into the phylodynamics, host associations, and transmission patterns of HPAI H5N1 viruses. It emphasizes the importance of enhanced surveillance programs targeting key avian hosts and high-risk geographic areas.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted between 14 October 2024 and 24 March 2025 across South Korea, focusing on wild birds and a leopard cat as part of the national HPAI surveillance program. A total of 43 cases in wild birds and 1 case in a leopard cat were detected.
analysis.methods: Whole-genome sequencing of 51 isolates was performed to investigate their phylogenetic relationships, and Bayesian continuous and discrete trait phylodynamic analyses were conducted using HA gene sequences to identify viral introduction routes and host associations.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that wild ducks served as the primary reservoirs for viral transmission in the wild bird population, and great egrets (Ardea alba) appeared to be more frequently affected than other species, indicating possible seasonal differences in disease outcomes.

The study highlights the importance of surveillance in key avian hosts and high-risk areas. However, the findings are based on observational data, which may introduce biases. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on surveillance rather than experimental methods.

title_zh: 新型重配高致病性禽流感 A (H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b病毒通过韩国野生鸟类的多次引入和传播,2024-2025年
source_body_en: Abstract Between 14 October 2024 and 24 March 2025, 43 cases of clade 2.3.4.4b highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) type A (H5N1) infections in wild birds and 1 case in a leopard cat were detected through the national HPAI surveillance program. We performed whole-genome sequencing of 51 isolates and investigated their phylogenetic relationships. Phylogenetic analyses identified nine distinct genotypes, designated Kor24–25A to Kor24–25I. The most commonly detected genotype, Kor24–25A ( n = 24), was frequently detected in Pelecaniformes and was most prevalent between December 2024 and January 2025. Bayesian continuous and discrete trait phylodynamic analyses using HA gene sequences identified the three most probable routes of viral introduction via Gyeonggi, Jeju, and the southern coastal areas of the Korean Peninsula and suggested that wild ducks served as the primary reservoirs facilitating viral transmission in the wild bird population. During the 2024–2025 season, great egrets ( Ardea alba ) appeared to be more frequently affected than other wild bird species, suggesting possible seasonal differences in species-specific disease outcomes among wild birds. This study provides valuable insights into the phylodynamics, host associations, and transmission patterns of HPAI H5N1 viruses. It emphasizes the importance of enhanced surveillance programs targeting key avian hosts and high-risk geographic areas.

title: A Phase 1/2 Dose-Ranging Safety and Immunogenicity Study of mRNA-Based Candidate Pandemic Influenza Vaccines in Healthy Adults.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza A viruses pose a persistent pandemic threat. We report safety, reactogenicity, and immunogenicity findings for mRNA-1018 pandemic influenza vaccine candidates from a phase 1/2 study in healthy adults. METHODS: In part A, participants were randomized to receive 1 of 4 mRNA-1018 candidates at 1 of 3 dose levels across 2 influenza A groups: (1) H5N8/H5-only or (2) H7N9/H7-only. Part B participants were randomized to receive H5-only-CG. The primary objectives were to evaluate the safety and reactogenicity. The secondary objectives included evaluation of humoral immunogenicity through day 205 by hemagglutination inhibition (HAI), neuraminidase inhibition, and microneutralization assays. RESULTS: Parts A and B comprised 1195 and 304 dosed participants, respectively. Overall, solicited local adverse reactions (ARs) within 7 days of vaccination occurred in 76.8% of participants across vaccine candidates and dose levels, most commonly injection-site pain. Solicited systemic ARs were reported in 62.8% of participants, most frequently fatigue and headache. Postvaccination immune responses, assessed absolutely, by HAI titers and dynamically, by seroconversion rates, tended to increase with vaccine dose. H5-based candidates induced stronger strain-specific HAI. CONCLUSIONS: Vaccine candidates were sufficiently well tolerated and immunogenic. Further development of mRNA pandemic influenza vaccines is warranted.Clinical Trials Registration.
journal: Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America

analysis.summary_en: This phase 1/2 study evaluated the safety and immunogenicity of mRNA-based pandemic influenza vaccine candidates in healthy adults. The research aimed to address the persistent pandemic threat posed by influenza A viruses. Participants were randomized to receive different mRNA-1018 candidates at varying dose levels, with some groups receiving H5N8 or H7N9-specific vaccines. The study found that solicited local and systemic adverse reactions were common, with injection-site pain and fatigue being the most frequently reported. Immune responses, measured by hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) titers and seroconversion rates, increased with higher vaccine doses. H5-based vaccines showed stronger strain-specific immune responses. The results suggest that these vaccine candidates are well-tolerated and immunogenic, supporting further development. However, the study's focus on healthy adults limits its applicability to broader populations, and the moderate evidence level reflects the need for additional research.

title: Mathematical modeling of in vitro replication dynamics for multiple highly pathogenic avian influenza clade 2.3.4.4 viruses in chicken and duck cells
abstract: The introduction, spread, and subsequent detection of highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) in poultry are influenced by the virus replication fitness, transmission fitness, and virulence. Quantifying these fitness parameters is important for implementing surveillance and control measures for poultry. This study employs an avian in vitro model using primary chicken embryo fibroblast and duck embryo fibroblast to identify cellular correlates of fitness for a reference panel of eight dominant, highly pathogenic avian influenza clade 2.3.4.4 virus genotypes (H5N1, H5N8, and H5N6) isolated between 2014 and 2024. Because HPAIVs are pantropic in poultry, the use of primary fibroblasts could provide a robust systemic model to assess virus fitness in different poultry species. By integrating longitudinal infectious virus titers and cytopathogenicity data with a mathematical model, which delineates cell populations into susceptible, latent, infectious, and dead compartments, we disentangled "traditional" virological parameters such as peak virus titer and time to 50% cell death from mechanistic parameters, including the infecting time ([Formula: see text]), generation time ([Formula: see text]), and basic reproduction number (R0). Our results confirm host-specific fitness characteristics consistent with in vivo observations. This study underscores the potential of integrating avian in vitro models with mathematical modeling to provide high-resolution characterization of genetically similar viruses, building toward rapid risk assessments of novel HPAIVs.IMPORTANCEHighly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreaks in poultry have resulted in the culling of millions of animals over the past decade. The introduction and spread of HPAI in poultry are driven by the ability of the virus to replicate, transmit, and cause disease, which varies among different poultry species. These viral fitness traits can change quickly through mutations or reassortment, leading to new variants with an altered risk of introduction and transmission. In this study, we integrated an in vitro and mathematical model to assess the viral fitness of genetically similar viruses and the risk they represent for two important poultry species. This approach offers a rapid and scalable alternative to traditional animal models, aligning with the 3R's principle and supporting rapid assessment of the viral fitness of emerging virus variants for poultry. This approach can be easily expanded to other species, including humans, and is suitable to assess the viral fitness of all viral pathogens.
authors: Wim H. M. van der Poel

abstract_zh: 高致病性禽流感 病毒 (HPAIV) 在家禽中的引入、传播和后续检测受到病毒复制适应性、传播 适应性和毒力的影响。量化这些健康参数对于实施 监测 和家禽控制措施非常重要。本研究采用禽类体外模型,使用原代鸡胚成纤维细胞和鸭胚成纤维细胞来鉴定 2014 年至 2024 年间分离的 8 个主要 高致病性禽流感 分支 2.3.4.4 病毒基因型(H5N1、H5N8 和 H5N6)参考组的细胞适应性相关性。由于 HPAIV 在家禽中具有泛嗜性,因此使用原代成纤维细胞可以提供强大的适应性。评估不同家禽物种病毒适应性的系统模型。通过将纵向感染性病毒滴度和细胞致病性数据与数学模型相结合,将细胞群划分为易感区、潜伏区、感染区和死区,我们将“传统”病毒学参数(例如峰值病毒滴度和细胞死亡 50% 的时间)与机械参数(包括感染时间([公式:参见文本])、世代时间([公式:参见文本])和基本繁殖数 (R0) 分开)。我们的结果证实了 宿主 特定的健身特征与体内观察结果一致。这项研究强调了将禽类体外模型与数学模型相结合的潜力,以提供遗传相似病毒的高分辨率特征,从而实现对新型 HPAIV 的快速风险评估。重要性 家禽中的高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) 暴发 在过去十年中已导致数百万只动物被扑杀。高致病性禽流感在家禽中的引入和传播是由病毒的复制、传播和引起疾病的能力驱动的,而不同的家禽种类之间的病毒复制、传播和致病的能力不同。这些病毒适应性特征可以通过 突变 或重配快速改变,从而产生具有改变的引入风险和 传播 的新变体。在这项研究中,我们整合了体外和数学模型来评估遗传相似病毒的病毒适应性及其对两种重要家禽物种的风险。这种方法为传统动物模型提供了一种快速且可扩展的替代方案,符合 3R 原则,并支持对家禽新兴病毒变种的病毒适应性进行快速评估。这种方法可以很容易地扩展到包括人类在内的其他物种,并且适合评估所有病毒病原体的病毒适应性。

title: The mammalian-adaptive PB2-E627K substitution preserves viral fitness of clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 HPAIV in birds.
abstract: Since emerging in 2020, clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 high pathogenicity avian influenza virus (HPAIV) has disseminated globally, causing substantial infection and mortality in wild birds and poultry. Additionally, numerous spill-over events into mammals have occurred, including mass mortalities and sporadic human infections. Such events can drive the acquisition of mammalian-adaptive mutations, which further increase the risk to humans; the most well characterised mutation is the glutamate to lysine change at amino acid position 627 in the polymerase basic 2 protein (PB2-627K). Across avian influenza viruses, PB2-627K enhances polymerase activity and replication in mammalian cells, increasing zoonotic and pandemic potential. However, bioinformatic analyses indicate that PB2-627K remains rare among clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses circulating in avian populations. Here, we investigated the impact of PB2-627K on viral fitness in avian hosts to assess the potential for mammalian-adapted viruses to re-establish in birds, mimicking infection of avian species following scavenging on mammalian species where PB2-627K has already emerged. Using a representative H5N1 virus (European genotype AB), PB2-627K increased polymerase activity and replication in human cells without compromising replication in avian cells. A mammalian-derived PB2-627K H5N1 isolate from a fox exhibited comparable replication kinetics and transmission efficiency in chickens and ducks to a closely related PB2-627E virus. Notably, PB2-627K remained genetically stable at consensus level following infection and transmission in both avian hosts. These findings demonstrate that mammalian-adaptive mutations acquired during spill-over can be maintained in avian populations, potentially elevating zoonotic risk and underscoring the importance of surveillance for such mutations in birds.

title_zh: 哺乳动物适应性 PB2-E627K 取代保留了鸟类中 clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 HPAIV 的病毒适应性。
source_body_en: Since emerging in 2020, clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 high pathogenicity avian influenza virus (HPAIV) has disseminated globally, causing substantial infection and mortality in wild birds and poultry. Additionally, numerous spill-over events into mammals have occurred, including mass mortalities and sporadic human infections. Such events can drive the acquisition of mammalian-adaptive mutations, which further increase the risk to humans; the most well characterised mutation is the glutamate to lysine change at amino acid position 627 in the polymerase basic 2 protein (PB2-627K). Across avian influenza viruses, PB2-627K enhances polymerase activity and replication in mammalian cells, increasing zoonotic and pandemic potential. However, bioinformatic analyses indicate that PB2-627K remains rare among clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses circulating in avian populations. Here, we investigated the impact of PB2-627K on viral fitness in avian hosts to assess the potential for mammalian-adapted viruses to re-establish in birds, mimicking infection of avian species following scavenging on mammalian species where PB2-627K has already emerged. Using a representative H5N1 virus (European genotype AB), PB2-627K increased polymerase activity and replication in human cells without compromising replication in avian cells. A mammalian-derived PB2-627K H5N1 isolate from a fox exhibited comparable replication kinetics and transmission efficiency in chickens and ducks to a closely related PB2-627E virus. Notably, PB2-627K remained genetically stable at consensus level following infection and transmission in both avian hosts. These findings demonstrate that mammalian-adaptive mutations acquired during spill-over can be maintained in avian populations, potentially elevating zoonotic risk and underscoring the importance of surveillance for such mutations in birds.
abstract_zh: 自2020年出现以来,分支2.3.4.4b H5N1高致病性禽流感病毒(HPAIV)已在全球传播,在野生鸟类和家禽中造成大量感染和死亡率。此外,还发生了许多向哺乳动物蔓延的事件,包括大规模死亡和零星人类感染。此类事件可能会促使获得哺乳动物适应性 突变,从而进一步增加人类面临的风险;最充分表征的 突变 是聚合酶碱性 2 蛋白 (PB2-627K) 中氨基酸位置 627 处的谷氨酸到赖氨酸的变化。在 禽流感 病毒中,PB2-627K 增强哺乳动物细胞中的聚合酶活性和复制,增加人畜共患和大流行的可能性。然而,生物信息学分析表明,PB2-627K 在禽类群体中传播的分支 2.3.4.4b H5N1 病毒中仍然很少见。在这里,我们研究了 PB2-627K 对禽类 宿主 病毒适应性的影响,以评估适应哺乳动物的病毒在鸟类中重新建立的可能性,模拟鸟类在清除已经出现 PB2-627K 的哺乳动物物种后的感染。使用代表性的 H5N1 病毒(欧洲基因型 AB),PB2-627K 增加了人类细胞中的聚合酶活性和复制,而不影响禽类细胞中的复制。来自狐狸的哺乳动物来源的 PB2-627K H5N1 分离物在鸡和鸭中表现出与密切相关的 PB2-627E 病毒相当的复制动力学和 传播 效率。值得注意的是,在两种禽类 宿主 中感染 传播 后,PB2-627K 在一致水平上保持遗传稳定。这些发现表明,在溢出过程中获得的哺乳动物适应性 突变 可以在鸟类种群中维持,这可能会增加人畜共患风险,并强调 监测 对于鸟类中此类 突变 的重要性。

title: Infection and transmission dynamics of bovine and human influenza A H5N1 viruses in mouse and hamster models
abstract: ABSTRACT Here we investigated the pathogenesis and contact transmission of bovine- and human-derived highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b genotype B3.13 viruses in mammalian models. Using reverse genetics, we rescued three naturally occurring viruses, rTX2/24 (bovine-derived), rTexas/37, and rMichigan/90 (both human-derived), and compared their infection dynamics, replication, and pathogenicity with the wild-type bovine TX2/24 strain in vitro and in vivo . All four viruses demonstrated comparable replication kinetics in four mammalian cell lines. However, the rMichigan/90 strain exhibited smaller plaques in bovine and human cells. In vivo studies showed that mice infected with any of the viruses succumbed to infection within 4–5 days; however, mice infected with the rMichigan/90 virus exhibited slightly lower viral replication and shedding compared with the other strains. The hamster model showed a milder infection phenotype than mice in which all viruses induced body weight loss and oral shedding, with robust virus replication observed in tissues, but the rMichigan/90 virus presented reduced replication and shedding. Contact transmission studies in hamsters revealed limited transmissibility for these viruses, with only one out of four animals inoculated with the rMichigan/90 virus transmitting it to a naïve contact. These findings indicate that both bovine- and human-derived H5N1 genotype B3.13 viruses present high pathogenicity in rodent models, though the overall respiratory transmissibility remains low in the hamster model. IMPORTANCE Influenza A H5N1 virus spilled over from wild birds into dairy cattle in the United States in 2024. Since then, an increased number of human infections—with at least 71 confirmed cases—have been confirmed. In the present study, we evaluated and compared the pathogenicity and transmissibility of a bovine and two human H5N1 viruses of the genotype B3.13. Our results show that while all viruses are pathogenic in mouse and hamster models, the bovine isolate TX2/24 presents a broader tissue tropism than the human-derived viruses. Contact transmission studies revealed a limited ability of these viruses to transmit in the hamster contact transmission model. These findings highlight the high pathogenicity of H5N1 viruses in mammals and demonstrate that their respiratory transmissibility potential remains low in the hamster model.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在在哺乳动物模型中研究牛源和人源 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 基因型 B3.13 病毒的 发病机制 和接触 传播。背景突出显示 H5N1 病毒 跨物种溢出 在 2024 年从 野生鸟类 进入美国奶牛,引发了对人畜共患 传播 和人类感染的担忧。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用反向遗传学拯救了三种天然存在的病毒:rTX2/24(牛源性)、rTexas/37和rMichigan/90(均源性),并在体外和体内比较了它们与野生型牛TX2/24毒株的感染动态、复制和致病性。在小鼠和仓鼠中进行体内研究,以评估病毒复制、脱落和传播性。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员利用反向遗传学拯救了这些病毒,并在体外和体内比较了它们的感染动态、复制和致病性。体内研究涉及用病毒感染小鼠和仓鼠,并通过接触 传播 实验监测病毒复制、脱落和传播能力。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有四种病毒在四种哺乳动物细胞系中都表现出类似的复制动力学。在小鼠中,与其他毒株相比,rMichigan/90 病毒的病毒复制和脱落率略低。在仓鼠中,所有病毒都会导致体重减轻和口腔脱落,并且组织复制强劲,但 rMichigan/90 病毒的复制和脱落减少。接触者 传播 研究显示,传染性有限,只有四分之一的动物接种了 rMichigan/90 病毒,将病毒传播给初次接触者。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,牛源和人源 H5N1 基因型 B3.13 病毒在啮齿动物模型中均表现出高致病性,尽管其呼吸道传播潜力在仓鼠模型中仍然较低。这些结果凸显了需要进一步研究 H5N1 病毒在不同 宿主 模型中的传播性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究深入了解了H5N1病毒在哺乳动物模型中的致病性和传播性,这对于了解人畜共患传播风险以及在动物和人类群体中制定有效的监测和禽流感控制策略至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于啮齿动物模型的体外和体内实验,可能无法完全代表人类或更广泛的动物 传播 动力学。证据是中等的,因为研究结果仅限于特定模型,并且没有考虑其他潜在的 宿主 或 传播 路线。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用反向遗传学拯救了三种天然存在的病毒:rTX2/24(牛源性)、rTexas/37和rMichigan/90(均源性),并在体外和体内比较了它们与野生型牛TX2/24毒株的感染动态、复制和致病性。在小鼠和仓鼠中进行体内研究,以评估病毒复制、脱落和传播性。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员利用反向遗传学拯救了这些病毒,并在体外和体内比较了它们的感染动态、复制和致病性。体内研究涉及用病毒感染小鼠和仓鼠,并通过接触 传播 实验监测病毒复制、脱落和传播能力。
analysis_zh.main_results: 所有四种病毒在四种哺乳动物细胞系中都表现出类似的复制动力学。在小鼠中,与其他毒株相比,rMichigan/90 病毒的病毒复制和脱落率略低。在仓鼠中,所有病毒都会导致体重减轻和口腔脱落,并且组织复制强劲,但 rMichigan/90 病毒的复制和脱落减少。接触者 传播 研究显示,传染性有限,只有四分之一的动物接种了 rMichigan/90 病毒,将病毒传播给初次接触者。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,牛源和人源 H5N1 基因型 B3.13 病毒在啮齿动物模型中均表现出高致病性,尽管其呼吸道传播潜力在仓鼠模型中仍然较低。这些结果凸显了需要进一步研究 H5N1 病毒在不同 宿主 模型中的传播性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究深入了解了H5N1病毒在哺乳动物模型中的致病性和传播性,这对于了解人畜共患传播风险以及在动物和人类群体中制定有效的监测和禽流感控制策略至关重要。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于啮齿动物模型的体外和体内实验,可能无法完全代表人类或更广泛的动物 传播 动力学。证据是中等的,因为研究结果仅限于特定模型,并且没有考虑其他潜在的 宿主 或 传播 路线。

title: Emerging respiratory infectious diseases: Clinical aspects for rapid identification and management.
abstract: Emerging respiratory infectious diseases increasingly arise at the human-animal-environment interface and challenge clinicians with rapidly evolving diagnostic, therapeutic, and infection-control decisions. This narrative review summarizes clinically relevant viral and bacterial pathogens that may present as severe respiratory disease, but are easily mistaken for common community-acquired infections during early illness. We focus on zoonotic influenza A viruses, including contemporary H5N1, Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV), hantaviruses, Nipah virus, and inhalational bacterial threats such as anthrax, pneumonic plague, tularemia, and melioidosis. These infections may progress from non-specific symptoms to severe pneumonia, acute respiratory distress syndrome, shock, neurological complications, disseminated infection, or death. Timely recognition depends on careful assessment of travel, occupational and recreational exposures, animal contact, outbreak signals, and pathogen-specific syndromic clues. Multiplex molecular diagnostics can support early triage and exclusion of common pathogens, but targeted PCR, culture, serology, sequencing, and reference laboratory confirmation remain essential. Management requires prompt supportive care, appropriate isolation, public health notification, and pathogen-directed antimicrobial, antiviral, antitoxin, or prophylactic strategies where available. By integrating clinical presentation, diagnostics, treatment, vaccines, and One Health considerations, this review aims to translate knowledge on emerging infections into practical bedside preparedness.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on avian influenza A viruses, emphasizing their role as emerging respiratory infectious diseases that challenge clinicians with rapidly evolving diagnostic and therapeutic decisions. It highlights the clinical presentation of these viruses, which can mimic common community-acquired infections, and underscores the importance of careful exposure assessment for timely recognition. The review outlines the necessity of molecular diagnostics, targeted PCR, culture, serology, and sequencing for accurate identification. It also stresses the importance of supportive care, isolation, and pathogen-directed interventions in management. While the review provides a broad overview of the clinical and diagnostic challenges, it lacks specific evidence on treatment effectiveness or long-term outcomes. The integration of clinical, diagnostic, and One Health perspectives is recommended to improve preparedness for these zoonotic threats.

abstract_zh: 新兴呼吸道传染病越来越多地出现在人类与动物环境的交界处,并给临床医生快速发展的诊断、治疗和感染控制决策带来挑战。这篇叙述性综述总结了临床相关的病毒和细菌病原体,这些病原体可能表现为严重的呼吸道疾病,但在疾病早期很容易被误认为是常见的社区获得性感染。我们专注于人畜共患甲型流感病毒,包括当代 H5N1、中东呼吸综合征冠状病毒 (MERS-CoV)、汉坦病毒、尼帕病毒,以及炭疽、肺鼠疫、兔热病和类鼻疽等吸入性细菌威胁。这些感染可能从非特异性症状发展为严重肺炎、急性呼吸窘迫综合征、休克、神经系统并发症、播散性感染或死亡。及时识别取决于对旅行、职业和娱乐暴露、动物接触、暴发 信号和病原体特异性症状线索的仔细评估。多重分子诊断可以支持常见病原体的早期分类和排除,但靶向 PCR、培养、血清学、测序和参考实验室确认仍然至关重要。管理需要及时的支持护理、适当的隔离、公共卫生通知以及针对病原体的抗菌药物、抗病毒药物、抗毒素或可用的预防策略。通过整合临床表现、诊断、治疗、疫苗 和 One Health 考虑因素,本综述旨在将新发感染的知识转化为实际的床边准备。

title: Mallard super-shedders of avian influenza exhibit distinct cloacal microbial abundance profiles
abstract: ABSTRACT In many infectious disease systems, a small fraction of hosts accounts for a disproportionate share of transmission, but the biological basis of this heterogeneity remains poorly resolved. In avian influenza, mallards show substantial variation in viral shedding, raising the possibility that only a subset of individuals contributes strongly to environmental contamination and onward spread. To examine whether host microbiome structure is associated with this variation, we experimentally infected wild, captive mallards with low-pathogenic avian influenza virus. We characterized cloacal microbiomes across control, low-shedding, and high-shedding birds using shotgun metagenomic sequencing combined with read-based taxonomic profiling and co-assembled metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) reconstruction. Although infected and uninfected birds were highly similar in species presence-absence, abundance-based analyses showed clear differences in shared taxa, particularly in high-shedding birds relative to controls. Differentially abundant taxa were dominated by taxa that belonged to groups that include host-associated opportunists, consistent with compositional imbalance rather than complete community restructuring. The phylum Pseudomonadota, especially the families Enterobacteriaceae and Moraxellaceae, is well represented. Together, these findings suggest that avian influenza infection is associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in species membership and that microbiome structure is associated with heterogeneity in shedding in a key wildlife reservoir. IMPORTANCE A small fraction of infected hosts often accounts for a disproportionate share of pathogen shedding, but the biological factors underlying this variation remain poorly understood. In experimentally infected mallards, a key wildlife reservoir for avian influenza A viruses, we found that high viral shedding was associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in microbial species membership. These results suggest that host-associated microbiome structure may be linked to shedding heterogeneity and could help explain why some individuals contribute more strongly to environmental contamination and onward transmission.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the biological basis of heterogeneity in viral shedding among infected hosts, specifically in mallards, a key wildlife reservoir for avian influenza A viruses. The background highlights that a small fraction of infected hosts often accounts for a disproportionate share of pathogen shedding, but the underlying factors remain poorly understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved experimentally infecting wild, captive mallards with low-pathogenic avian influenza virus to examine whether host microbiome structure is associated with variation in viral shedding.
analysis.methods: Cloacal microbiomes were characterized using shotgun metagenomic sequencing combined with read-based taxonomic profiling and co-assembled metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) reconstruction.
analysis.main_results: Abundance-based analyses showed clear differences in shared taxa, particularly in high-shedding birds relative to controls, while infected and uninfected birds were highly similar in species presence-absence.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that avian influenza infection is associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in microbial species membership, and that microbiome structure is linked to shedding heterogeneity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results could help explain why some individuals contribute more strongly to environmental contamination and onward transmission, potentially informing surveillance and prevention strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study design limitations include the use of wild, captive mallards, which may not fully represent the natural host population, and the focus on low-pathogenic avian influenza virus, which may not generalize to highly pathogenic strains.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to understand the biological basis of heterogeneity in viral shedding among infected mallards, a key wildlife reservoir for avian influenza A viruses. By characterizing cloacal microbiomes, the research found that high viral shedding was associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in microbial species membership. These findings could help explain why some individuals contribute more strongly to environmental contamination and onward transmission, potentially informing surveillance and prevention strategies.

title_zh: 禽流感 的野鸭超级脱落者表现出独特的泄殖腔微生物丰度分布
source_body_en: ABSTRACT In many infectious disease systems, a small fraction of hosts accounts for a disproportionate share of transmission, but the biological basis of this heterogeneity remains poorly resolved. In avian influenza, mallards show substantial variation in viral shedding, raising the possibility that only a subset of individuals contributes strongly to environmental contamination and onward spread. To examine whether host microbiome structure is associated with this variation, we experimentally infected wild, captive mallards with low-pathogenic avian influenza virus. We characterized cloacal microbiomes across control, low-shedding, and high-shedding birds using shotgun metagenomic sequencing combined with read-based taxonomic profiling and co-assembled metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) reconstruction. Although infected and uninfected birds were highly similar in species presence-absence, abundance-based analyses showed clear differences in shared taxa, particularly in high-shedding birds relative to controls. Differentially abundant taxa were dominated by taxa that belonged to groups that include host-associated opportunists, consistent with compositional imbalance rather than complete community restructuring. The phylum Pseudomonadota, especially the families Enterobacteriaceae and Moraxellaceae, is well represented. Together, these findings suggest that avian influenza infection is associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in species membership and that microbiome structure is associated with heterogeneity in shedding in a key wildlife reservoir. IMPORTANCE A small fraction of infected hosts often accounts for a disproportionate share of pathogen shedding, but the biological factors underlying this variation remain poorly understood. In experimentally infected mallards, a key wildlife reservoir for avian influenza A viruses, we found that high viral shedding was associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in microbial species membership. These results suggest that host-associated microbiome structure may be linked to shedding heterogeneity and could help explain why some individuals contribute more strongly to environmental contamination and onward transmission.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在许多传染病系统中,宿主 的一小部分占 传播 的不成比例的份额,但这种异质性的生物学基础仍然没有得到很好的解决。在 禽流感 中,野鸭在病毒脱落方面表现出巨大差异,这增加了只有一小部分个体对环境污染和进一步传播做出重大贡献的可能性。为了检查 宿主 微生物组结构是否与这种变异相关,我们通过实验用低致病性 禽流感 病毒感染野生圈养野鸭。我们使用鸟枪法宏基因组测序结合基于读取的分类学分析和共组装宏基因组组装 基因组 (MAG) 重建,对对照、低脱落和高脱落鸟类的泄殖腔微生物组进行了表征。尽管受感染和未受感染的鸟类在物种存在与不存在方面高度相似,但基于丰度的分析显示,共享类群存在明显差异,特别是相对于对照组而言,高脱落鸟类。差异丰富的类群以属于包括 宿主 相关机会主义者在内的群体的类群为主,这与组成不平衡而不是完全的群落重组一致。假单胞菌门,特别是肠杆菌科和莫拉菌科,有很好的代表性。总之,这些发现表明,禽流感 感染与泄殖腔细菌类群丰度的变化有关,而不是物种成员的广泛变化,并且微生物组结构与关键野生动物 储存宿主 脱落的异质性有关。重要性 一小部分受感染的 宿主 通常导致病原体脱落的比例不成比例,但这种变异背后的生物学因素仍然知之甚少。在实验感染的野鸭(储存宿主 禽流感 A 病毒的一种重要野生动物)中,我们发现大量病毒脱落与泄殖腔细菌类群丰度的变化有关,而不是与微生物物种成员的广泛变化有关。这些结果表明,宿主 相关的微生物组结构可能与脱落异质性有关,并有助于解释为什么某些个体对环境污染和 传播 的影响更大。

title: A modelling challenge to improve preparedness for highly pathogenic avian influenza epidemics: objectives, design and synthetic data generation
abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) is among the most significant disease threats to poultry worldwide. Modelling challenges, where independent teams address a common epidemiological scenario, can support the development of response capabilities and strengthen communication between modellers and risk managers. Despite the established benefits of these exercises, they remain uncommon in animal health, and none have previously addressed avian influenza. Here Jolly Island, an artificial landscape of 9160 poultry farms with five production types, was developed and seeded with stochastic HPAI epidemics that ran their course over a three-to-four month period. From January through April 2026, 45 registered teams across five continents investigated a selected synthetic epidemic, producing probabilistic forecasts, inferring transmission drivers, and evaluating counterfactual control policies. Here the objectives, design choices, and data generation of the HPAI Modelling Challenge are described in full, covering transmission processes, surveillance system operations, and control strategy implementation, along with the selected epidemic trajectory, the narrative situation reports supplied to the teams at each phase, and the complete phase-specific datasets released to them. As the opening paper of this special issue, here is provided the foundation upon which all subsequent contributions, where teams document their approaches and analyses, are built.

title: Administration of the mRNA-H5 vaccine to ferrets via jet injection provides protective immunity against the H5N1 influenza virus
abstract: The highly pathogenic avian influenza virus subtype H5Nx is rapidly evolving and infecting various species of wild and domestic mammals, including cattle, highlighting its pandemic potential for humans. To combat the pandemic threat, it is essential to develop suitable vaccine platforms, including mRNA vaccines, the efficacy of which largely depends on the delivery system. This study evaluates the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of the mRNA-H5 vaccine, delivered via lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) and jet injection (JI). The aim of the study was to evaluate the immunogenic and protective properties of the experimental mRNA-H5 vaccine in a ferret model. MATERIALS AND METHODS. Ferrets were immunized twice with the mRNA-H5 vaccine at a dose of 30 μg formulated with LNPs and at a dose of 100 μg administered by JI. Sera from immunized ferrets were analyzed using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) against the recombinant HA/H5 protein, an enzyme-linked immunospot (ELISpot) assay using a pool of specific peptides, and a virus neutralization assay in MDCK-SIAT1 cell culture using the influenza virus strain A/turkey/Stavropol/320-01/2020 (H5N8). Immunized ferrets were intranasally challenged with 5 LD 50 of the influenza virus strain A/dalmatian pelican/Kalmykia/ 330-10V/2023 (H5N1), and their status was recorded for 14 days after challenge. Using ELISA, it was established that specific antibody titers were determined in groups of animals immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine administered by JI or formulated with LNPs; the average titers in the groups were 1:180,000 and 1:4,000,000, respectively. Using the virus neutralization assay, sera from animals immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine administered by JI or formulated with LNPs had virus-neutralizing activity; the average 50% neutralizing titers were 1:250 and 1:1500, respectively. The ELISpot assay showed that in groups of ferrets immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine, specific cellular immunity was induced. Immunization with the mRNA-H5 vaccine provided 100% protection against mortality in ferrets challenged with 5 LD 50 of the influenza virus strain A/dalmatian pelican/Kalmykia/330-10V/2023 (H5N1). This study demonstrated the effective induction of virus-specific humoral and cellular immune responses in ferrets immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine administered by JI or formulated with LNPs.

This study demonstrated the effective induction of virus-specific humoral and cellular immune responses in ferrets immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine administered by JI or formulated with LNPs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed due to the rapid evolution of H5Nx avian influenza viruses and their ability to infect various mammals, including cattle, which highlights the pandemic potential for humans. The research aimed to address the need for effective vaccine platforms, particularly mRNA vaccines, whose efficacy depends on the delivery system.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a ferret model to evaluate the immunogenic and protective properties of the experimental mRNA-H5 vaccine. Ferrets were immunized twice with the vaccine at different doses and delivery methods, and their immune responses were assessed following viral challenge.
analysis.methods: The study used enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), enzyme-linked immunospot (ELISpot) assay, and virus neutralization assay in MDCK-SIAT1 cell culture to analyze immune responses. Ferrets were challenged with a specific H5N1 strain, and their status was monitored for 14 days post-challenge.
analysis.main_results: Immunized ferrets showed high specific antibody titers, with average titers of 1:180,000 and 1:4,000,000 in the JI and LNP groups, respectively. The virus neutralization assay revealed average 50% neutralizing titers of 1:250 and 1:1500. The ELISpot assay confirmed the induction of specific cellular immunity in vaccinated ferrets.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that the mRNA-H5 vaccine effectively induces both humoral and cellular immune responses in ferrets, which is a novel result in the context of evaluating vaccine delivery methods for H5N1 influenza.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide important insights into the potential of mRNA vaccines for protecting against H5N1 influenza, which could inform future vaccine development and public health strategies for avian-origin zoonotic infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a ferret model, which may not fully represent human immune responses. However, the evidence is strong as it directly reports on the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of the vaccine in a relevant animal model.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of an mRNA-H5 vaccine against H5N1 influenza in a ferret model. The research is motivated by the pandemic potential of H5Nx avian influenza viruses, which can infect various mammals. The vaccine was administered via lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) and jet injection (JI), and immune responses were assessed using ELISA, ELISpot, and virus neutralization assays. The results showed that both delivery methods induced high antibody titers and neutralizing activity, with the JI group demonstrating 100% protection against mortality following viral challenge. The findings suggest that the mRNA-H5 vaccine is effective in generating immune responses against H5N1 influenza, which has implications for vaccine development. However, the study is limited to a ferret model, and the evidence is strong due to the direct evaluation of vaccine efficacy in this context.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于 H5Nx 进化 病毒的快速 进化 及其感染包括牛在内的各种哺乳动物的能力,因此需要进行这项研究,这凸显了人类大流行的可能性。该研究旨在满足对有效 疫苗 平台的需求,特别是 mRNA 疫苗,其功效取决于递送系统。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在雪貂模型中进行,旨在评估实验 mRNA-H5 疫苗 的免疫原性和保护特性。使用 疫苗 以不同剂量和递送方法对雪貂进行两次免疫,并在病毒攻击后评估其 免疫应答。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究在MDCK-SIAT1细胞培养物中使用酶联免疫吸附测定(ELISA)、酶联免疫斑点(ELISpot)测定和病毒中和测定来分析免疫应答。雪貂接受了特定 H5N1 毒株的攻击,并在攻击后 14 天监测其状态。
elements_zh.main_results: 免疫后的雪貂表现出较高的特异性抗体滴度,JI组和LNP组的平均滴度分别为1:180,000和1:4,000,000。病毒中和测定显示平均 50% 中和滴度为 1:250 和 1:1500。ELISpot 测定证实了接种疫苗的雪貂中诱导了特异性细胞免疫。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,mRNA-H5 疫苗 在雪貂中有效诱导体液和细胞 免疫应答,这是评估 H5N1 流感 疫苗 递送方法的新结果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为了解 mRNA 疫苗 预防 H5N1 流感的潜力提供了重要见解,这可以为未来 疫苗 的开发和针对禽源人畜共患感染的公共卫生策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于雪貂模型,可能无法完全代表人类 免疫应答。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它直接报告了 疫苗 在相关动物模型中的免疫原性和保护功效。

abstract_zh: 高致病性禽流感 病毒亚型 H5Nx 正在迅速进化并感染各种野生和家养哺乳动物,包括牛,凸显了其对人类的大流行潜力。为了应对大流行的威胁,必须开发合适的疫苗平台,包括mRNA 疫苗,其功效在很大程度上取决于递送系统。本研究评估了通过脂质纳米颗粒 (LNP) 和喷射注射 (JI) 递送的 mRNA-H5 疫苗 的免疫原性和保护功效。该研究的目的是评估实验性 mRNA-H5 疫苗 在雪貂模型中的免疫原性和保护特性。材料和方法。用LNP配制的mRNA-H5 疫苗以30μg的剂量和通过JI施用的100μg的剂量对雪貂进行两次免疫。使用针对重组 HA/H5 蛋白的酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA)、使用特定肽库的酶联免疫斑点 (ELISpot) 测定以及使用流感病毒株 A/turkey/Stavropol/320-01/2020 (H5N8) 在 MDCK-SIAT1 细胞培养物中进行病毒中和测定,对免疫雪貂的血清进行分析。用5 LD 50 的流感病毒株A/达尔马提亚鹈鹕/卡尔梅克亚/330-10V/2023 (H5N1)鼻内攻击免疫的雪貂,并在攻击后记录它们的状态14天。使用 ELISA,确定在用 JI 施用的 mRNA-H5 疫苗 或用 LNP 配制的 mRNA-H5 疫苗 免疫的动物组中测定特异性抗体滴度;各组的平均滴度分别为1:180,000和1:4,000,000。使用病毒中和试验,用 JI 施用的 mRNA-H5 疫苗 或用 LNP 配制的动物的血清具有病毒中和活​​性;平均50%中和效价分别为1:250和1:1500。ELISpot 测定显示,在用 mRNA-H5 疫苗 免疫的雪貂组中,诱导了特异性细胞免疫。在用 5 LD 50 流感病毒株 A/达尔马提亚鹈鹕/卡尔梅克/330-10V/2023 (H5N1) 攻击的雪貂中,用 mRNA-H5 疫苗 进行免疫可提供针对 死亡率 的 100% 保护。这项研究证明,用 JI 施用的 mRNA-H5 疫苗 或用 LNP 配制的 mRNA-H5 疫苗 免疫的雪貂中,可以有效诱导病毒特异性体液和细胞 免疫应答。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于 H5Nx 进化 病毒的快速 进化 及其感染包括牛在内的各种哺乳动物的能力,因此需要进行这项研究,这凸显了人类大流行的可能性。该研究旨在满足对有效 疫苗 平台的需求,特别是 mRNA 疫苗,其功效取决于递送系统。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在雪貂模型中进行,旨在评估实验 mRNA-H5 疫苗 的免疫原性和保护特性。使用 疫苗 以不同剂量和递送方法对雪貂进行两次免疫,并在病毒攻击后评估其 免疫应答。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究在MDCK-SIAT1细胞培养物中使用酶联免疫吸附测定(ELISA)、酶联免疫斑点(ELISpot)测定和病毒中和测定来分析免疫应答。雪貂接受了特定 H5N1 毒株的攻击,并在攻击后 14 天监测其状态。
analysis_zh.main_results: 免疫后的雪貂表现出较高的特异性抗体滴度,JI组和LNP组的平均滴度分别为1:180,000和1:4,000,000。病毒中和测定显示平均 50% 中和滴度为 1:250 和 1:1500。ELISpot 测定证实了接种疫苗的雪貂中诱导了特异性细胞免疫。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,mRNA-H5 疫苗 在雪貂中有效诱导体液和细胞 免疫应答,这是评估 H5N1 流感 疫苗 递送方法的新结果。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为了解 mRNA 疫苗 预防 H5N1 流感的潜力提供了重要见解,这可以为未来 疫苗 的开发和针对禽源人畜共患感染的公共卫生策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于雪貂模型,可能无法完全代表人类 免疫应答。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它直接报告了 疫苗 在相关动物模型中的免疫原性和保护功效。

title: An adenovirus-based mucosal vaccine induces cross-neutralizing antibodies and protects against lethal H5N1 infection in ferrets
abstract: Background H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) has been detected in multiple animal species, including humans, posing a significant threat to public health. Vaccines capable of eliciting robust mucosal and systemic immunity are needed to protect against HPAI infection. Methods First- and second-generation non-replicating adenovirus type-5 vectored vaccines expressing hemagglutinin (HA) from clade 2.1.3.2 (ND1.1) and clade 2.3.4.4b (VXA-H5-02), were administered via peroral route to ferrets. Mucosal and systemic immunogenicity were evaluated. Protective efficacy, viral burden, and shedding was assessed against clade 2.3.4.4b challenge, for clade-matched VXA-H5–02 and clade-mismatched ND1.1 vaccines. Results Immunization elicited mucosal immunity and serum neutralizing activity in ferrets against homologous and heterologous clades. All control animals rapidly succumbed to the lethal 2.3.4.4b clade challenge, compared with survival rates of 38% and 100% in the ND1.1 and VXA-H5–02 vaccine groups, respectively. VXA-H5–02 immunization significantly reduced illness, viral burden, and shedding. Conclusion Second-generation VXA-H5–02 is a promising vaccine candidate capable of inducing systemic and mucosal immunity, offering broad protection against HPAI.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the efficacy of an adenovirus-based mucosal vaccine against H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI). The research is motivated by the public health threat posed by HPAI, which has been detected in multiple species, including humans. The study design involves administering first- and second-generation non-replicating adenovirus type-5 vaccines expressing hemagglutinin from clade 2.1.3.2 (ND1.1) and clade 2.3.4.4b (VXA-H5-02) via the peroral route to ferrets. Protective efficacy, viral burden, and shedding were assessed against clade 2.3.4.4b challenge. Results showed that immunization elicited mucosal immunity and serum neutralizing activity against homologous and heterologous clades. All control animals succumbed to the challenge, while survival rates were 38% and 100% in the ND1.1 and VXA-H5–02 vaccine groups, respectively. The authors interpret these findings as evidence that VXA-H5–02 is a promising vaccine candidate capable of inducing broad protection against HPAI. The study's significance lies in its potential to inform vaccine development for avian influenza in humans and other species. However, the study is limited to ferrets and does not report human trials, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is strong based on direct observations of survival and viral burden reduction.

title: Highly pathogenic avian influenza as a systemic risk - implications for control and preparedness
abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) has evolved from episodic outbreaks into a globally entrenched, multi-host panzootic, with recurrent spillover into mammals. The expanding host range and increasing wildlife–livestock interfaces challenge traditional control strategies, increase opportunities for viral adaptation, and thereby elevate zoonotic risk. We therefore propose that HPAI should be reframed as a long-term systemic risk requiring resilience-based governance, and strengthened One Health control and preparedness.

The expanding host range and increasing wildlife–livestock interfaces challenge traditional control strategies, increase opportunities for viral adaptation, and thereby elevate zoonotic risk.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a conceptual analysis of HPAI as a systemic risk, focusing on its global spread and implications for control and preparedness. It examines the evolving nature of HPAI and its impact on multiple host species and ecosystems.
analysis.methods: The methods involve a review of existing literature and an analysis of the ecological and epidemiological characteristics of HPAI, including its host range and transmission dynamics.
analysis.main_results: The study reports that HPAI has transitioned from episodic outbreaks to a persistent, multi-host panzootic, with repeated spillover events into mammals.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as highlighting the need to reframe HPAI as a long-term systemic risk, requiring resilience-based governance and enhanced One Health approaches for control and preparedness.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the development of more robust surveillance, control, and preparedness strategies for HPAI, emphasizing the importance of a One Health approach to mitigate zoonotic risks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on an abstract-only review, which may limit the depth of analysis. However, the evidence is grounded in the reported characteristics of HPAI and its implications for public health.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the evolving nature of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) as a systemic risk, highlighting its transition from episodic outbreaks to a persistent, multi-host panzootic with recurrent spillover into mammals. The research underscores the challenges posed by the expanding host range and increasing wildlife–livestock interfaces, which threaten traditional control strategies and elevate zoonotic risk. The authors propose reframing HPAI as a long-term systemic risk, necessitating resilience-based governance and strengthened One Health approaches for effective management. The study's implications emphasize the need for improved surveillance, control, and preparedness strategies to address the ongoing threat of HPAI. While the evidence is based on an abstract-only review, the findings are supported by the reported characteristics of HPAI and its ecological and epidemiological impact. The analysis suggests a moderate confidence level due to the limited depth of the evidence provided.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 已从偶发性 暴发 演变成全球范围内根深蒂固的多 宿主 泛动物疫情,并在哺乳动物中反复出现 跨物种溢出。宿主范围的扩大和野生动物与牲畜接触的增加对传统的控制策略提出了挑战,增加了病毒适应的机会,从而提高了人畜共患病的风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究对高致病性禽流感作为一种系统性风险进行了概念分析,重点关注其全球传播及其对控制和准备的影响。它研究了高致病性禽流感的演变性质及其对多个 宿主 物种和生态系统的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及对现有文献的回顾以及对 HPAI 的生态和流行病学特征的分析,包括其 宿主 范围和 传播 动态。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究报告称,HPAI 已从偶发性 暴发 转变为持续性、多 宿主 的大流行,在哺乳动物中反复出现 跨物种溢出 事件。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为强调需要将高致病性禽流感重新定义为一种长期系统性风险,需要基于复原力的治理和增强的“同一个健康”方法来进行控制和准备。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为制定更强大的 HPAI 监测、控制和准备策略提供了信息,强调了“One Health”方法对于减轻人畜共患病风险的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于仅摘要的综述,这可能会限制分析的深度。然而,证据是基于所报道的高致病性禽流感的特征及其对公共卫生的影响。

title: In- Silico Evaluation of Matrix Gene RT-PCR Primer and Probe Binding Site Stability in Influenza A H5N1 and Implications for Diagnostic Assay Performance
abstract: Abstract Background: Real-time RT-PCR assays targeting the influenza A matrix (M) gene are widely used in clinical laboratories for routine detection of H5N1 infections. Viral genetic drift may compromise primer and probe binding efficiency, potentially affecting assay sensitivity. Continuous evaluation of binding site stability is therefore essential for diagnostic reliability. Methods: Forty-nine full-length matrix gene sequences of influenza A (H5N1) collected between 1996–2025 and included isolates from: Homo sapiens, Avian species, other mammalian hosts (accession numbers provided on the tables). Only sequences covering nucleotide positions 79–175 were included. Gene sequences were retrieved from the NCBI GenBank database. Multiple sequence alignment was performed using (MUSCLE in MEGA software). Primer and probe binding regions corresponding to coordinates 79–97 (forward primer), 120–138 (probe), and 154–175 (reverse primer) were evaluated for nucleotide mismatches. Frequencies of substitutions were calculated and stratified by host and temporal distribution. Results: All sequences fully covered the evaluated binding regions. The majority of isolates demonstrated complete conservation within primer and probe sites. Observed substitutions were infrequent and primarily single nucleotide mismatches. No extensive multi-site disruptions were identified within any binding region. Substitution patterns showed temporal clustering but did not suggest widespread destabilization of assay target regions. Conclusion: The results indicate that the evaluated matrix gene RT-qPCR assay demonstrates substantial tolerance to isolated nucleotide substitutions, with most circulating strains remaining within predicted tolerance limits. Observed limited mismatches are unlikely to significantly compromise diagnostic assay performance. Continued molecular surveillance of primer and probe binding sites is recommended to maintain analytical sensitivity in clinical laboratories.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the stability of primer and probe binding sites in the matrix gene of influenza A H5N1 viruses using in-silico methods. The research highlights the importance of monitoring genetic drift in these regions to ensure diagnostic assay reliability. By analyzing 49 full-length matrix gene sequences collected between 1996 and 2025, the study finds that most isolates show complete conservation within the binding sites, with infrequent single nucleotide mismatches. These findings suggest that the current RT-qPCR assay for H5N1 remains robust against minor genetic variations, although continued molecular surveillance is recommended to maintain sensitivity. The study's abstract-only evidence provides moderate confidence in its conclusions, as it lacks detailed statistical analysis or long-term validation data.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 1996 年至 2025 年间收集的 49 个甲型流感 (H5N1) 全长矩阵基因序列,包括智人、鸟类和其他哺乳动物 宿主 的分离株。仅包含覆盖核苷酸位置 79-175 的序列。

elements_zh.main_results: 所有序列完全覆盖评估的结合区域。大多数分离株在引物和探针位点内表现出完全保守。观察到的取代并不常见,而且主要是单核苷酸错配。在任何结合区域内均未发现广泛的多位点破坏。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,评估的基质基因 RT-qPCR 检测显示出对分离核苷酸取代的显着耐受性,大多数流行菌株仍保持在预测的耐受限度内。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 建议使用引物和探针结合位点的连续分子 监测 以保持临床实验室的分析灵敏度。

abstract_zh: 摘要背景:针对甲型流感基质 (M) 基因的实时 RT-PCR 检测广泛应用于临床实验室,用于 H5N1 感染的常规检测。病毒遗传漂移可能会损害引物和探针的结合效率,从而可能影响测定灵敏度。因此,持续评估结合位点稳定性对于诊断可靠性至关重要。方法:1996 年至 2025 年期间收集的 49 个甲型流感 (H5N1) 全长基质基因序列,包括来自以下菌株的分离株:智人、鸟类、其他哺乳动物 宿主(表中提供了登录号)。仅包含覆盖核苷酸位置 79-175 的序列。基因序列取自 NCBI GenBank 数据库。使用(MEGA软件中的MUSCLE)进行多序列比对。评估对应于坐标 79-97(正向引物)、120-138(探针)和 154-175(反向引物)的引物和探针结合区域的核苷酸错配。通过 宿主 和时间分布计算和分层替换频率。结果:所有序列完全覆盖评估的结合区域。大多数分离株在引物和探针位点内表现出完全保守。观察到的取代并不常见,而且主要是单核苷酸错配。在任何结合区域内均未发现广泛的多位点破坏。替换模式显示时间聚类,但并不表明分析目标区域普遍不稳定。结论:结果表明,评估的基质基因 RT-qPCR 检测显示出对分离核苷酸取代的显着耐受性,大多数流行菌株仍处于预测的耐受限度内。观察到的有限错配不太可能显着影响诊断分析性能。建议使用引物和探针结合位点的连续分子 监测 以保持临床实验室的分析灵敏度。

title: H5 influenza virus mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (LNP) vaccination elicits adaptive immune responses in Holstein calves.
abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 circulated widely in lactating dairy cows in the United States following the initial detection in 2024. Due to the critical need for intervention strategies for this outbreak, we evaluated antibody and cellular immune responses of a clade 2.3.4.4b H5 mRNA-LNP vaccine in calves. We found that the H5 mRNA-LNP vaccine induced a robust antibody and CD8+ T cell-mediated immune response and conferred protection against clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 infection.IMPORTANCEIt is important to develop vaccines that limit clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 infection in cattle. In this study, we found that a new H5 mRNA-lipid nanoparticle vaccine is immunogenic when delivered intramuscularly to male Holstein calves.

title: Hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha inhibition mitigates inflammatory responses induced by H9N2 avian influenza virus
abstract: ABSTRACT H9N2 avian influenza virus (AIV) poses significant threats to poultry and public health, with the potential to contribute to the emergence of more virulent influenza strains. Hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF-1α) plays a crucial role in viral pathogenesis, immune regulation, and inflammation, making it a promising target for therapeutic intervention. Here, we explored the involvement of HIF-1α in H9N2 AIV pathogenesis and associated inflammatory responses. Our data revealed that HIF-1α exacerbates inflammation induced by H9N2 AIV infection through its regulation of mitochondrial fitness. Additionally, we investigated Sotetsuflavone (Seo), a naturally derived flavonoid, for its potential to modulate inflammatory responses following H9N2 infection. Molecular docking coupled with surface plasmon resonance assays indicated that Seo exhibits robust binding affinity to HIF-1α, implying a direct inhibitory mechanism. Subsequent in vitro studies demonstrated that Seo greatly reduced the production of inflammatory cytokines, including IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α, through suppressing the HIF-1α signaling pathway in HD11 cells infected with H9N2 AIV. Correspondingly, in vivo experiments established that Seo administration significantly ameliorated pulmonary inflammation in H9N2-infected mice, while also enhancing alveolar epithelial repair, as evidenced by increased expression of type II alveolar epithelial cell markers Abca3 and Sftpb. Collectively, these findings identify Seo as a potent inhibitor of HIF-1α, highlighting its therapeutic potential in mitigating inflammation and lung damage associated with influenza virus infection. IMPORTANCE H9N2 avian influenza virus triggers inflammatory lung injury via hypoxia-inducible factor-1 alpha (HIF-1α)-mediated dysregulation of mitochondrial function. The natural flavonoid Sotetsuflavone (Seo) directly binds and inhibits HIF-1α, as confirmed by molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance assays. In H9N2-infected HD11 cells, Seo suppresses HIF-1α signaling, reducing IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α production. In vivo , Seo treatment attenuates pulmonary inflammation and enhances alveolar epithelial repair in mice, upregulating type II pneumocyte markers (Abca3 and Sftpb). These findings identify Seo as a promising HIF-1α-targeted therapeutic for influenza-associated immunopathology.

Hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF-1α) plays a crucial role in viral pathogenesis, immune regulation, and inflammation, making it a promising target for therapeutic intervention. Here, we explored the involvement of HIF-1α in H9N2 AIV pathogenesis and associated inflammatory responses. Our data revealed that HIF-1α exacerbates inflammation induced by H9N2 AIV infection through its regulation of mitochondrial fitness. Additionally, we investigated Sotetsuflavone (Seo), a naturally derived flavonoid, for its potential to modulate inflammatory responses following H9N2 infection. Molecular docking coupled with surface plasmon resonance assays indicated that Seo exhibits robust binding affinity to HIF-1α, implying a direct inhibitory mechanism. Subsequent in vitro studies demonstrated that Seo greatly reduced the production of inflammatory cytokines, including IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α, through suppressing the HIF-1α signaling pathway in HD11 cells infected with H9N2 AIV. Correspondingly, in vivo experiments established that Seo administration significantly ameliorated pulmonary inflammation in H9N2-infected mice, while also enhancing alveolar epithelial repair, as evidenced by increased expression of type II alveolar epithelial cell markers Abca3 and Sftpb. Collectively, these findings identify Seo as a potent inhibitor of HIF-1α, highlighting its therapeutic potential in mitigating inflammation and lung damage associated with influenza virus infection. IMPORTANCE H9N2 avian influenza virus triggers inflammatory lung injury via hypoxia-inducible factor-1 alpha (HIF-1α)-mediated dysregulation of mitochondrial function. The natural flavonoid Sotetsuflavone (Seo) directly binds and inhibits HIF-1α, as confirmed by molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance assays. In H9N2-infected HD11 cells, Seo suppresses HIF-1α signaling, reducing IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α production. In vivo , Seo treatment attenuates pulmonary inflammation and enhances alveolar epithelial repair in mice, upregulating type II pneumocyte markers (Abca3 and Sftpb). These findings identify Seo as a promising HIF-1α-targeted therapeutic for influenza-associated immunopathology.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究 HIF-1α 在 H9N2 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 发病机制 中的作用,并探索 Sotetsuflavone (Seo) 作为治疗剂的潜力。H9N2 AIV 对家禽和公共卫生构成重大威胁,并有可能导致毒性更强的流感病毒株的出现。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究探讨了 HIF-1α 在 H9N2 AIV 发病机制 中的参与以及体外和体内相关炎症反应。该研究是使用 HD11 细胞和 H9N2 感染的小鼠进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 使用分子对接和表面等离子共振测定来确认 Seo 与 HIF-1α 的结合亲和力。使用感染H9N2 AIV的HD11细胞进行体外研究,并在感染H9N2的小鼠中进行体内实验。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,Seo 通过抑制感染 H9N2 AIV 的 HD11 细胞中的 HIF-1α 信号通路,减少炎性细胞因子的产生,包括 IL-1β、IL-6 和 TNF-α。在体内,Seo 治疗 显着改善 H9N2 感染小鼠的肺部炎症并增强肺泡上皮修复。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明 Seo 是 HIF-1α 的有效抑制剂,突显了其在减轻流感病毒感染相关炎症和肺损伤方面的治疗潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Seo 可能是一种很有前途的 HIF-1α 靶向疗法,用于治疗流感相关的免疫病理学,有可能降低肺损伤的严重程度并增强肺泡上皮修复。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到使用单一黄酮类化合物和单一 禽流感 病毒亚型的限制,这可能无法推广到其他亚型或物种。由于该研究的体外和体内实验性质,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 摘要 H9N2 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 对家禽和公共卫生构成重大威胁,并有可能导致毒性更强的流感病毒株的出现。缺氧诱导因子 1-α (HIF-1α) 在病毒 发病机制、免疫调节和炎症中发挥着至关重要的作用,使其成为治疗干预的有希望的靶点。在这里,我们探讨了 HIF-1α 在 H9N2 AIV 发病机制 中的参与以及相关的炎症反应。我们的数据显示,HIF-1α 通过调节线粒体健康度,加剧了 H9N2 AIV 感染引起的炎症。此外,我们还研究了 Sotetsuflavone (Seo)(一种天然衍生的黄酮类化合物),了解其调节 H9N2 感染后炎症反应的潜力。分子对接结合表面等离子共振测定表明 Seo 对 HIF-1α 表现出强大的结合亲和力,这意味着直接抑制机制。随后的体外研究表明,Seo 通过抑制感染 H9N2 AIV 的 HD11 细胞中的 HIF-1α 信号通路,大大减少了炎症细胞因子的产生,包括 IL-1β、IL-6 和 TNF-α。相应地,体内实验证实,Seo 给药显着改善 H9N2 感染小鼠的肺部炎症,同时还增强肺泡上皮修复,II 型肺泡上皮细胞标记物 Abca3 和 Sftpb 表达增加证明了这一点。总的来说,这些发现将 Seo 确定为 HIF-1α 的有效抑制剂,突显了其在减轻与流感病毒感染相关的炎症和肺损伤方面的治疗潜力。重要性 H9N2 禽流感 病毒通过缺氧诱导因子 1 α (HIF-1α) 介导的线粒体功能失调引发炎症性肺损伤。分子对接和表面等离子共振测定证实,天然类黄酮 Sotetsuflavone (Seo) 直接结合并抑制 HIF-1α。在 H9N2 感染的 HD11 细胞中,Seo 抑制 HIF-1α 信号传导,减少 IL-1β、IL-6 和 TNF-α 的产生。在体内,Seo 治疗 可减轻小鼠肺部炎症并增强肺泡上皮修复,上调 II 型肺细胞标记物(Abca3 和 Sftpb)。这些发现表明 Seo 是一种有前途的 HIF-1α 靶向疗法,用于治疗流感相关的免疫病理学。

title: Recent advances in universal influenza vaccine platforms: paving the way for universal H5N1 vaccines and pandemic readiness
abstract: Abstract The H5N1 influenza threat is a significant issue to the overall health of the population in the world, and it demands new approaches in vaccine development and implementation. The critical path forward is the development of universal vaccine platforms, which provide long-term cross-protection against various H5N1 strains. This type of vaccines, based on conserved regions of viruses, is necessary to provide long term immunity against antigenic variation. The future of vaccines should be based on the ability to generate both cellular and humoral immunity and provide the greatest level of protection against a variety of viral variants. It is also crucial that agile manufacturing capacities are established, which can swiftly expand the production of vaccines to satisfy the demand in the world in the case of an influenza outbreak. The technology of mRNA vaccines, viral vectors, or microneedle patches can be adapted to novel strains rapidly and responds effectively to the situation when rapid and effective responses are required. Also, fair global distribution policies can be crucial to make it possible to make vaccines available to the population of low- and middle-income countries. The international response needs to focus on equity, whereby inequality in access to vaccines is minimized. This has been the ultimate solution of combining universal vaccines, cross-protection, agile production, and equity over the world to reduce the threat of H5N1 pandemic. By developing these measures, the world community can be more ready to the upcoming outbreak of influenza, and access to a vaccine can be timely, extensive, and efficient.

title_zh: 通用流感 疫苗 平台的最新进展:为通用 H5N1 疫苗 和大流行准备铺平道路

abstract_zh: 摘要 H5N1 流感威胁是对世界人口整体健康的重大问题,它需要 疫苗 的开发和实施采取新的方法。前进的关键道路是开发通用 疫苗 平台,该平台提供针对各种 H5N1 毒株的长期交叉保护。这种类型的 疫苗 基于病毒的保守区域,对于提供针对抗原变异的长期免疫力是必要的。疫苗的未来应该基于产生细胞和体液免疫的能力,并提供针对各种病毒变种的最大程度的保护。同样重要的是,建立敏捷的制造能力,可以迅速扩大疫苗的产量,以满足全球在流感暴发的情况下的需求。mRNA 疫苗、病毒媒介或微针贴片技术可以快速适应新菌株,并在需要快速有效反应时有效应对情况。此外,公平的全球分配政策对于使中低收入国家的人口能够获得 疫苗 至关重要。国际应对措施需要注重公平,从而最大限度地减少获得 疫苗 的不平等。这是将全球通用的疫苗、交叉保护、敏捷生产和公平相结合的最终解决方案,以减少H5N1大流行的威胁。通过制定这些措施,国际社会可以为即将到来的流感 暴发 做好更充分的准备,并且可以及时、广泛和高效地获得 疫苗。

title: Nowcasting officially reported highly pathogenic avian influenza outbreak counts under heterogeneous reporting delays
abstract: Official animal disease series are often incomplete due to delays in reporting. This retrospective observational study evaluated whether increased model complexity enhances probabilistic nowcasts of eventual officially reported outbreak-equivalent counts. We reconstructed historical information states from a fixed extraction from the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) World Animal Health Information System (WAHIS), which included 46,860 highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) and 72,690 African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks. Twelve prespecified methods were assessed over 78 locked cutoffs for 2024–2025 using the Weighted Interval Score (WIS), calibration diagnostics, block bootstrap, simulation, and a separately frozen USDA APHIS transfer evaluation. The primary HPAI analysis included 35,880 observations from 115 country–host units. At week closure, only 7.6% of eventual HPAI and 6.7% of ASF outbreak equivalents were visible, with completeness varying by host, region, year, season, and workload. The prespecified primary hypothesis was not supported: the delay-aware temporal network scored 6.9% worse than the hierarchical Bayesian comparator, and the relational graph changed WIS by only 0.4%. Gradient-boosted quantile regression improved WIS by 18.5% (absolute difference −0.0397, 95% interval −0.0553 to −0.0255), but the improvement reached 26.0% among high-volume reporters and reversed to a 6.3% deficit among units with minimal reporting history. Conditioning on the partial count was 24.7% worse than a matched no-delay network at cohort age 0 and performed better thereafter. The slower-reporting ASF system reversed the pooled contrast, whereas the APHIS module improved WIS by 10.1% after system-specific retraining. Adding an explicit mass at zero enhanced the transparent comparator by 18.8% and resulted in no detectable difference from gradient boosting; the neural model remained 17.4% worse under the same recalibration. In exploratory analyses, gradient boosting cleared the prespecified 5% gate under all six cohort definitions and all three maturity horizons. Performance deteriorated markedly for high-volume countries and regions excluded from training. These estimates pertain to eventual officially reported outbreak equivalents under the surveillance conditions studied, not undetected infections.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of reporting delays on the accuracy of nowcasting models for highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreaks. Using data from the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) World Animal Health Information System (WAHIS), the researchers evaluated whether increased model complexity could improve probabilistic nowcasts. They found that the delay-aware temporal network performed worse than the hierarchical Bayesian comparator, and the relational graph had minimal impact on the Weighted Interval Score (WIS). Gradient-boosted quantile regression showed some improvement, but its effectiveness varied by reporting volume. The study highlights the challenges of using incomplete data for outbreak prediction and suggests the need for more robust models that account for reporting delays. However, the results are limited by the retrospective nature of the analysis and potential issues with generalisability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决由于报告延迟而导致官方动物疾病系列不完整的挑战,特别是 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI)。该研究试图评估增加模型复杂性是否可以改善 暴发 等效计数的概率即时预报。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用世界动物卫生组织 (WOAH) 世界动物卫生信息系统 (WAHIS) 的数据进行了一项回顾性观察研究,其中包括 46,860 例 HPAI 和 72,690 例非洲猪瘟 (ASF) 暴发。主要 HPAI 分析涉及来自 115 个国家 宿主 单位的 35,880 个观测值。
elements_zh.methods: 使用加权区间评分 (WIS)、校准诊断、块引导、模拟和单独冻结的 USDA APHIS 转移评估,对 2024-2025 年 78 个锁定截止点对 12 种预先指定的方法进行了评估。作为方法的一部分,还测试了梯度增强分位数回归和零时的显式质量。
elements_zh.main_results: 在一周结束时,只有 7.6% 的最终 HPAI 和 6.7% 的 ASF 暴发 等效项可见,其完整性因 宿主、地区、年份、季节和工作量而异。延迟感知时间网络的得分比分层贝叶斯比较器差 6.9%,而关系图仅改变 WIS 0.4%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 预先指定的主要假设不受支持,这表明模型复杂性的增加并没有显着增强 暴发 等效计数的临近预报。该研究通过评估报告延迟对模型性能的影响引入了一种新颖的方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为 HPAI 暴发 开发更准确的临近预报模型提供了信息,这可以改进 监测 和响应策略。他们还强调了公共卫生和兽医科学报告延迟的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 对于被排除在培训之外的高容量国家和地区,绩效显着恶化,这表明普遍性受到限制。由于该研究是基于历史数据和回顾性分析,因此证据是中等的。

title: Dynamical Systems Analysis of Avian Influenza Models: A Scoping Review of Mathematical Frameworks
abstract: Mathematical models have been widely used to investigate avian influenza transmission and disease dynamics. However, to our knowledge, no review has specifically and systematically examined avian influenza models from a qualitative dynamical systems perspective. Consequently, the modelling frameworks, analytical techniques, and theoretical findings generated from these studies have not been adequately synthesized. This scoping review will address this gap by identifying and classifying avian influenza models that employ qualitative dynamical systems analyses and synthesizing their key theoretical findings. The review will provide a clearer understanding of disease transmission, persistence, stability, and control, while identifying gaps and priorities for future modelling research
